edgeAATolerance.reason: Measured on CI 39722299676 (default macOS keyboard access: Tab skips Buttons): identical in all five shots, maxInBand 61, over-32 pixels 12 of about 7900, mean 0.28. The Mac keeps the TextField focused throughout and no Button gets a ring; Windows matches (a focus request on a Button is refused unless Tab focuses all controls). Tolerance = measured plus margin.
